title: Oldest brother comes round in Phoenix; New Mexico ghost towns
summary: Howard, the eldest, becomes supportive when Norvo plays Phoenix; he also recalls boyhood hikes through abandoned mining towns like Madrid, New Mexico.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, the oldest was -- yeah, the oldest was a couple of years later he was in Phoenix and I came through with Oliver Shaw, I played Phoenix, it was a real small town, he was living there.
Phoenix was a small town?

Yeah. He had-- he was married and had two boys. And played this theater and he was the proudest thing in the world. That was the first inclination information that I had that he was -- it was good and --
Oh, that's good.
-- his oldest boy walked out on the stage and he knew -- he knew me from going to -- (unintelligible) was right out of Santa Fe.
Yeah.

I loved New Mexico when I was a kid. I used to run around all those mountains in those days and we used to go back in the hill country. They desert those towns where the 49 -- gold rush, you know they'd just leave -- left them.
Oh.
And the roads were overgrown, but this boy that I knew and we'd take.22's and we'd hike up to these places and they even had stoves with utensils on them and things like that.
How extraordinary.
And the churches and the -- of course the roof would be there, they're adobe, but they caved in and the --
Well you mean they'd heard that there was gold somewhere else and they just left --
No, when California they just left. There was mining, oh, probably silver mines, or zinc mines or something up there.
For heaven's sake.
And when they heard about the --
The gold --
-- the gold in California, they just up and left.
Yeah.
That was all through that country was like that.
How extraordinary.
But, -- [Recording Interruption]
Red -- well Red, let's see, I had to
interrupt us, but you were talking about the townsthere, in New Mexico --
Yeah, Madrid --
-- when you used to see your brother --
-- they called it Madrid, like Madrid in Spain, but it's Madrid there.
Oh, is it?
Yeah.
I see, I didn't know --
That's a ghost town now. I went there a couple of years ago and it's a ghost town.
Is it? Really?
Yeah, that's a beautiful little place.
Is it. Fancy that.
Ah -- anyway, when I played Phoenix, he was -- first inclination that I had that he -- and all through the time after that he was --
He supported --
Yeah, he used to write me if he heard something or if you did this or the other thing -- he heard -- he was very concerned with it.
Did he still play some piano?
Yeah, he played piano.
Did he ever accompany you at all?
No, no, no. He'd left home when I started
But you didn't go to the house and he had a piano --
He had a piano, but --
No, but I mean at his house?
No, after he went to college he never played too much.
